executive_summary: This is a placeholder briefing generated on first deploy. The first real scan will run automatically next Monday at 07:00 CET via GitHub Actions. You can also trigger a manual scan immediately from the Actions tab in your GitHub repository.

market.title: First real briefing arrives Monday
market.summary: GitHub Actions will run the weekly scan every Monday at 07:00 CET. The script calls Claude with web search enabled and writes the results back to this file automatically.
market.sowhat: No action needed — set up is complete. Trigger a manual run from GitHub Actions to get your first real briefing immediately.

thought.title: Add or change sources in sources.json
thought.summary: Open sources.json in your GitHub repository to add new sources, change focus topics, or deactivate sources temporarily. Set active to false to pause any source without deleting it.
thought.sowhat: No code changes needed — edit the JSON file directly on GitHub and commit. The next scan will pick up your changes automatically.

competitors.title: Trigger your first real scan now
competitors.summary: Go to your GitHub repository, click Actions, select Weekly Intelligence Scan, and click Run workflow. The scan takes 2-3 minutes and updates this page automatically.
competitors.sowhat: You will have your first real CMIplus intelligence briefing within minutes of triggering the manual run.
